permitted_operations: download and hash exact cell metadata file
read metadata rows and column names
record non-empty lineage-barcode counts and cross-condition overlap using cons_BC_lenti
record missingness for lineage and condition fields
forbidden_operations: score molecular states from gene expression
select favorable lineages from later outcomes
infer causal inheritance from barcode recurrence alone

qualification_rule.carrier_defined_if: at least 100 non-empty lineage barcodes are present and at least 20 lineage barcodes occur in two or more source-defined conditions
qualification_rule.continuity_defined_if: source metadata exposes at least two conditions and at least 20 lineages span conditions
